subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw expose an install-only `plugins install --agent` surface before per-agent runtime activation, uninstall/update cleanup, and plugin trust semantics are defined?
rationale: This PR changes public plugin CLI behavior and persisted install records for executable plugin code, but current runtime discovery and cleanup behavior still treat install records as shared/global in ways that can surprise operators.

options.title: Pause for a lifecycle contract
options.body: Require a maintainer-approved contract for scoped install identity, discovery/runtime visibility, update/uninstall cleanup, trust policy, and upgrade/doctor behavior before merging this surface.

options.title: Narrow to internal groundwork
options.body: Keep only non-public helpers/tests that do not add a CLI flag or persisted scoped records until the canonical issue has a settled product/security design.

options.title: Accept install-only semantics
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly ship this as an install-location-only feature, but the PR and docs must state that scoped installs are still globally discoverable and not an isolation boundary.

recommendation.title: Pause for a lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Require a maintainer-approved contract for scoped install identity, discovery/runtime visibility, update/uninstall cleanup, trust policy, and upgrade/doctor behavior before merging this surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin install/uninstall hardening and discovery-adjacent work make this the best available routing candidate for the lifecycle/security choice.
